Vulkan-Headers v1.4.339 (https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers, Apache-2.0 OR MIT, see LICENSE.md) — only
the headers llama.cpp's Vulkan backend includes: the C API (`vulkan.h`, `vulkan_core.h`, `vk_platform.h`, the video
headers `vulkan_core.h` pulls in) and Vulkan-Hpp (`vulkan.hpp` and the parts it includes). The NDK carries the C
headers only, and older ones.
